calculation.description: Use the negative five-session asset return as a cross-sectional reversal signal, amplifying reversal when the observation-only VIX has risen over the prior five completed sessions and attenuating it when VIX has not risen. VIX and asset returns are aligned through the same completed date; the signal predicts the next session return.
calculation.timing: At decision date t, use only data through completed session t-1; historical artifact is date-aligned signal at t with forward return beginning at t+1.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in each calendar year: 2020 0.05663, 2021 0.05036, 2022 0.11852, 2023 0.02648, 2024 0.08227, 2025 0.01227, 2026 0.04120. Cross-section is the 15-instrument benchmark universe; uncertainty remains material.
